elaine: Quick stub for managers: 5 ultra-short paste blocks for self-reviews and handoffs. Keep each line <140 chars.
omar: love short. can we have one for "what changed", one metric line, then a single ask?
lara: yep, and a hiring ops mini-brief for backfills. dropping a tight set below.
paul: add a tiny benefits pointer for comp/headcount asks so people ops knows what to expect.
hr-bot: Reminder: calibration schedule posted to People Ops calendar.

--- PASTE BLOCKS ---
Project evidence (one line):
- Evidence: Shipped [feature] for [users] -> reduced friction for [user task], improved adoption.
Metric anchor (one line):
- Metric: [metric] from [X] -> [Y] (delta +/-%).
Single-line ask (one line):
- Ask: Need [support/headcount/approval] to complete next phase; owner: @NAME; ETA: [date].
Manager handoff note (single para):
- Handoff: Status [dev/stage/prod]; pending items [A,B]; runbook/docs: [link]; key contacts: [names].
Hiring ops brief (3 bullets, comma separated):
- Role: covers [area], immediate project [A], weekly sync: [link]
- Must-know: critical stakeholders, active tickets/PRs, oncall/runbook
- Recruiter focus: probe [skills/behaviors], suggested panels: [names]
Benefits/policy clip (one line):
- Policy: For comp/headcount exceptions attach business case + org chart; people-ops typically responds in 3-5 business days.

--- SELF-REVIEW SCAFFOLD ---
1) What I moved: [decision/action] -> [impact in plain english]
2) Who I helped: [teams/people] -> [what improved]
3) What I need: [specific ask for manager/org]

elaine: I'll publish this as a handbook snippet and link it in the review form. please reply with phrasing edits. :sparkles:
